en:
## New Features

- Add layered outbound proxy overrides: on top of the global proxy setting, you can now override the proxy mode (default/direct/system/custom) individually for each AI provider, gateway platform, hook, web fetch, and the browser.
- Make Dynamic Spec task reminders configurable, with a global default injection interval and a per-narrator override.
- Automatically migrate and backfill legacy narrator todos into the Dynamic Spec task board on upgrade, so historical tasks are not lost.

## Performance

- Throttle Dynamic Spec reminders so subagents no longer re-read the spec file on every tool call, and advance the reminder cadence on hit rather than only on injection, avoiding repeated reads when all tasks are done or the fence is empty.

## Bug Fixes

- Fix a working narrator tab being demoted below other working tabs: subscribing to a narrator re-emitted its current "working" status, which re-ran the promotion logic; the tab is now only promoted on a real transition into working.
- Preload the Git panel's i18n resources for project, workspace, and narrator routes, removing the brief delay when opening the Git panel for the first time.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增分层出站代理覆盖：在全局代理设置之外，现在可为单个 AI 提供商、网关平台、hook、网页抓取和浏览器分别覆盖代理模式（默认/直连/系统/自定义）。
- Dynamic Spec 任务提醒可配置：支持全局默认注入间隔与叙述者级覆盖。
- 升级时自动将旧版叙述者 todos 迁移并回填到 Dynamic Spec 任务看板，避免历史任务丢失。

## 性能优化

- 为 Dynamic Spec 提醒加节流，子代理不再每次工具调用都重读 spec 文件；提醒 cadence 改为命中即推进而非仅在实际注入时推进，避免任务全部完成或护栏为空时重复读文件。

## 修复

- 修复工作中的叙述者 tab 被降到其它工作中 tab 之下的问题：订阅叙述者会 re-emit 其当前的 "working" 状态并重复触发提升逻辑，现改为仅在真正跃迁进入 working 时才提升。
- 为项目、工作区、叙述者路由预加载 Git 面板的 i18n 资源，消除首次打开 Git 面板时的短暂延迟。
